integrity: The proof is self-contained; finite computational checks are corroborative, not universal proofs. Closely related existing derivation formulas for selected characteristic-not-two forms are acknowledged. No claim of independent validation or exhaustive historical originality is made.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only rank-one derivations for nondegenerate one-dimensional-commutator bilinear-form Leibniz algebras. The normal form depends on a chosen splitting; higher-rank derivations and degenerate forms are not treated.
title: Rank-one derivations of bilinear-form Leibniz algebras and the characteristic-two idempotent jump
